question: Under identical complete-room input and decoding, what rooms do the frozen base and the two approved two-update adapters actually produce? Mechanism pilot follow-up only; no generalization or professional benefit claim.
stop_rule: First infrastructure failure stops the batch. Valid done/no-action or tool rejection is a retained policy outcome. No prompt/task/threshold/adapter changes after output.

scope.primary_reporting: Per requirement evidence (pass under stated proxy / violated / unknown), inventory, actual meshes/contact and access, immutable geometry, exact actions/rejections/cost. Never replace full requirements by furniture count or free area.
scope.limitations: One unsealed source-inspired room with researcher dimensions. Two training steps per adapter. No blind human review, training convergence or generalization claim. Strong same-knowledge prompt/retrieval and action-only training controls remain future work.
